answer: Each epoch, a verifiably random grading panel is drawn from a large staked validator pool, so no fixed jury ever forms. A sybil attacker flooding the net with fake agents sees them scattered: each colluding island of identities gets reshuffled away every epoch, and any river of coordinated votes across rotations is flagged statistically and slashed. To stay influential the attacker must stake huge collateral on thousands of throwaway identities before each rotation, while earning little, like re-seeding a meadow
